hook: IIIT Junction flyover: *43 of 54* pillars done
hook_b: IIIT Junction flyover: *43 of 54* pillars done
tldr: Work on the 3.39-km signal-free interchange at Gachibowli's IIIT Junction picked up after the monsoon. Cyberabad Municipal Corporation says 43 of 54 foundation pillars are complete and beam work is underway. Target: May 2027.

beats.what: CMC is building three steel flyovers and a six-lane underpass at IIIT Junction under the H-CITI project; 43 of 54 pillars are done.
beats.why: IIIT Junction is one of the IT corridor's worst bottlenecks between ISB Road, DLF Road, Lingampally and Gachibowli.
beats.care: Expect construction slowdowns around IIIT Junction until the May 2027 target; once done, right turns from ISB Road skip the signal.

effects.label: 10-15 min saved at peak, officials say

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 18): heavy structural beam installation is now underway on the three interconnected steel flyover stretches.
